authority_notice.meaning: This file preserves the superseded staged holdout plan. Its 120/240 splits and old acceptance gates must not control current execution.

stage_1_screening.purpose: screen out clearly ineffective Judge or Bot directions; not a final quality conclusion
stage_1_screening.use_limit: after aggregate results are used for iteration, this set becomes regression data and can never be called final hidden again

stage_2_final_validation.purpose: validation and process diagnosis only; not a fresh hidden final set and not production-comparable Bot A/B evidence
stage_2_final_validation.max_cases_per_chat_scope: ordinary chats only; the two user-specified groups are exceptions and are counted by independent event cluster
stage_2_final_validation.specified_group_quota_rule: each specified group must contribute at least 20 independent event clusters; a case counts only after human identity, target-group identity, the source-specific cutoff, complete context, non-exposure and semantic-near-duplicate checks are all verified; otherwise final validation remains blocked

date_cutoff_policy.exception_scope: date only; identity, target-group, full-context, non-exposure, event-isolation and semantic-near-duplicate rules are unchanged

stage_2_final_validation.reuse_rule: no Stage 1 case, event cluster, thread or semantic near-duplicate may enter Stage 2

stage_2_required_strata.counting_rule: strata may overlap; labels are assigned before sealing by an independent curator and only aggregate counts are released

stage_2_capacity_audit.counting_scope: selected Stage 2 holdout after excluding Stage 1 events and deterministic conservative answer-near-duplicates; ordinary chats are capped at 3 cases, while the two specified groups use independently isolated event clusters
stage_2_capacity_audit.blocking_reason: all 240 cases were read by the strata-curation step, and their contexts contain only speaker/content; 0/240 are strictly production-comparable
stage_2_capacity_audit.required_next_input: report and obtain user approval for every production difference before any replay; do not start formal A/B with this set
stage_2_capacity_audit.capacity_note: all figures describe validation/process-diagnostic coverage only; case text, chat IDs, event IDs and answers remain private
stage_2_capacity_audit.non_negotiable_rule: do not fill any gap with the wrong same-name group, data outside the source-specific cutoff, exposed cases, unknown identity, incomplete context, split threads, direct repeats or semantic near-duplicates

judge: candidate beats frozen Judge baseline by at least 5 percentage points on Stage 2
overall human-vs-Bot identification accuracy is at least 75% and every major stratum is at least 65%
paired position-swap checks show no material A/B position bias
Judge remains diagnostic and cannot decide Bot promotion alone
bot: blind human paired comparison against frozen C0 has more wins than losses, two-sided sign-test p < 0.05, and net win rate improves by at least 10 percentage points
complex-large-group net win is positive, both specified groups do not regress, and private chat has no material regression
new factual hallucinations and new real-world action commitments are both zero
old-joke reuse, cross-round repetition and generation failures do not worsen
P95 latency stays within the frozen production SLO and does not increase by more than 10% versus C0 under the same replay conditions
